title: Option to automatically delete the folder where the vault is mounted when unmounting
line: Each vault can now remove its mount point folder while it is locked, so the empty folder no longer clutters the file manager.
explanation: Plasma Vault always kept the mount point folder (e.g. ~/Vaults/Name) when a vault was locked. Since 6.7 new gocryptfs vaults make that folder read-only with a lock icon, but the empty folder still sits in the file manager, and there was no way to have it go away like a removable device's mount folder. The configuration dialog's General tab gets a per-vault checkbox, "Remove the mount point folder while the vault is locked" (off by default). When it is on, locking the vault removes the folder (only if nothing but Plasma Vault's own .directory file is left in it, otherwise it is kept and locked as before), and unlocking creates it again before mounting; deleting a vault whose folder is gone no longer fails on the missing folder.

commits.message:
kded: add an option to remove the mount point while a vault is locked

The empty mount point folder stayed around while a vault was locked, so
it cluttered the file manager. A new per-vault option removes it when the
vault gets locked and creates it again when the vault is unlocked.

BUG: 442854
